boundary.note: boundary-2r is the defence for the future league; boundary-1 kept only as a legacy research baseline (model-enforced rules, no append-only); boundary-2 historical (reproduction of rev6-rev8 runs)

threat_model.attacker: own code and memory, public shop rules, own account data in the brief, the chat channel (Observation) and its own model via the broker; nothing of the defender implementation, DB, logs, cassettes, corpus GT, critique, keys
threat_model.defender: own implementation, data and logs, allowed chat messages; not the attacker's memory; in rev9 still in the broker process (not OS-isolated)
threat_model.evaluator: private fixtures, oracle, full logs, provenance registry, payload audit, hidden held-out
threat_model.broker: channel, LLM client with credentials, event log, payload audit; credentials never leave it
threat_model.paths: the in-process attacker (attacker_factory=None) is the historical research baseline: claim_level in_process_research
